related.title: Velero 1.17：還原相依圖與應用驗證的關鍵路徑
related.titleEn: Velero 1.17: restore dependencies and application-verification critical paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付snapshot-graph.json、reachable.csv、cleanup-candidates.csv與restore-proof.md；清楚標示MB計算是理想區塊模型，不是restic磁碟估算器。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver snapshot-graph.json, reachable.csv, cleanup-candidates.csv and restore-proof.md. State clearly that the MB calculation is an ideal chunk model rather than a restic on-disk storage estimator.
related.difference: 建立namespace、CRD、volume、workload及驗證五種工作，計算最早開始與完成；區分物件建立、資料可讀與服務驗收。
related.differenceEn: Model namespace, CRD, volume, workload and verification tasks with earliest starts and finishes. Distinguish object creation, readable application data and service acceptance instead of using one restore-status label.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: restic區分移除快照參照與清理不再需要的資料；本課以每區塊1MB且無封裝額外成本建模，實際釋放空間還受pack與重打包影響。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 S1引用a,b,c,d；S2引用c,d,e；S3引用d,e,f。全庫6個區塊，保留S2與S3，移除S1的引用。 保留聯集c,d,e,f共4MB，不可達a,b共2MB；S1的4MB不能全部清理，因c,d仍共享。

Velero還原有資源次序與外掛相關行為；本課工作時間及平行性是合成計畫，並不宣稱Velero會依此自動排程或保證應用一致性。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 namespace2分鐘與CRD3分鐘可同時開始；volume4分鐘在namespace後；workload2分鐘需CRD與volume完成；驗證3分鐘在workload後。 volume於6分鐘完成，workload於8，驗證於11；串列相加14分鐘會忽略允許平行，只有8分鐘則漏掉應用驗證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: restic separates removing snapshot references from pruning unneeded data. The model gives each chunk one MB with no packaging overhead; actual reclaimed space also depends on packs and repacking behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. S1 references a,b,c,d; S2 references c,d,e; S3 references d,e,f. The repository has six chunks. Retain S2 and S3 while removing only the S1 snapshot reference. The retained union c,d,e,f totals four MB; unreachable a,b total two MB. S1 four-MB content cannot all be reclaimed because c and d remain shared by retained snapshots.

Velero restoration has resource ordering and plugin-dependent behavior. Durations and parallelism below define a synthetic plan, not a claim that Velero automatically uses this schedule or guarantees application consistency. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Namespace takes two minutes and CRD three, starting in parallel. Volume takes four after namespace; workload takes two after both CRD and volume; verification takes three after workload. Volume finishes at minute six, workload at eight and verification at eleven. Summing every duration serially gives fourteen and ignores permitted parallelism; stopping at eight omits application verification.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Google SRE postmortems: case-mix bias and verification of improvement effects

related.differenceEn: Preserve scenario version, difficulty stratum and outcome. Calculate pooled and fixed-weight standardized proportions separately, maintaining an appropriate boundary between descriptive improvement and causal evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

SRE事後檢討要求可追蹤的改進；此課分層統計是原創驗證方法，不是Google規定的評分公式，也不能單靠前後對照排除所有混淆。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 改善前容易100件成功90、困難100件成功10；改善後容易900成功810、困難100成功10。層內成功率皆維持90%與10%。 前總成功100/200=50%，後820/1000=82%；以各50%固定權重標準化，前後皆(90%+10%)/2=50%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: restic separates removing snapshot references from pruning unneeded data. The model gives each chunk one MB with no packaging overhead; actual reclaimed space also depends on packs and repacking behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. S1 references a,b,c,d; S2 references c,d,e; S3 references d,e,f. The repository has six chunks. Retain S2 and S3 while removing only the S1 snapshot reference. The retained union c,d,e,f totals four MB; unreachable a,b total two MB. S1 four-MB content cannot all be reclaimed because c and d remain shared by retained snapshots.

SRE postmortem practice supports accountable improvement. The stratified calculation is an original verification method, not a prescribed Google scoring formula; before/after comparison alone cannot eliminate all confounding. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Before the change, easy cases have ninety successes out of 100 and hard cases ten out of 100. Afterward, easy cases have 810 out of 900 and hard cases ten out of 100. Pooled success rises from 100/200=50% to 820/1000=82%. Standardizing both periods to equal stratum weights gives (90%+10%)/2=50% in each period.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
